product.name: Monoprice Toslink S/PDIF 1x3 Splitter
product.description: This Toslink® S/PDIF 1x3 Splitter allows you to connect a single digital optical S/PDIF (Toslink) audio source to up to three devices, such as a television, audio amplifier, AV receiver, etc. It supports 2‑channel high definition audio sources, including LPCM, DTS®, and Dolby Digital™. It has a 96kHz sampling rate, supports signal re‑timing, and can transmit audio to distances up to 131 feet (40 meters) using an optical cable with a loss of less than 0.2dB/m.Features: Connect a single Toslink® digital optical S/PDIF audio source to up to three devicesSupports 2‑channel high definition audio sources, including LPCM, DTS®, and Dolby Digital™96kHz sampling rateSupports signal re‑timingCan transmit audio to distances up to 131 feet (40 meters) using an optical cable with a loss of less than 0.2dB/mOver voltage protectionUSB poweredSupport Files: User's Manual (Jul 20, 2021)Monoprice™, Blackbird™, the Blackbird logo, and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
